sections.content: A while loop repeats as long as its condition stays true. It is checked before every iteration — if it starts false, the body never runs.
While loops shine for "keep going until done" logic: reading input until a quit command, retrying failed operations, or processing streams.
Key points: always ensure the condition eventually becomes false, or you create an infinite loop that hangs the program.
